prompt: Add a product search API. (1) In `ProductRepository` add `public List<Product> searchByName(String keyword)` returning products whose name contains the keyword (case-insensitive), sorted by name ascending; a null or blank keyword returns an empty list. (2) In `ProductController` add `GET /api/products/search?q=<keyword>` that returns 200 with the matching products as JSON, or 400 Bad Request when q is missing or blank.

oracle_plan.instruction: Add GET /search endpoint delegating to productRepository.searchByName, 400 on blank q.
